source_document.body:
The U.S. Postal Service wants to make its fuel surcharge permanent and raise it from 8% to 11% on Jan. 17. It also proposed raising rates by an average of 5.9% across four domestic package services, including Ground Advantage and Priority Mail.
What’s Related
USPS filed notice of the changes with the Postal Regulatory Commission (PRC) on Thursday after the Postal Service Board of Governors approved them. The four domestic services are Priority Mail Express, Priority Mail, USPS Ground Advantage, and Parcel Select.
The surcharge began in April as a temporary 8% transportation-related increase set to expire Jan. 17. USPS cited rising fuel prices in proposing to raise the surcharge by three percentage points.
For now, the surcharge won't apply to international products. But several international services would go up an average of 7.9%, and USPS is reworking its country rate group structure and which countries fall into each group.
RELATED STORIES: USPS Lost $6.5 Billion Despite a $2.4 Billion Revenue Gain | USPS Opens Last-Mile Delivery Facilities to Competitive Bidding
Why prices are increasing
Fuel is a big part of the story. The national average price of diesel was $6.10 a gallon on Nov. 12, up from $3.76 a year earlier, according to AAA data cited by CBS News . CBS tied the jump to higher global oil prices linked to the war in Iran .
USPS is also still losing money. The agency reported a $6.5 billion net loss for fiscal 2026, down from $9 billion the year before, Supply Chain 24/7 reported . USPS said its shipping prices are set mainly by market conditions and that the new pricing is part of its ongoing modernization plan.
January's changes cap a busy year of USPS price moves. Published Ground Advantage rates rose about 7.8% in January 2026. In July, USPS changed how it calculates dimensional weight , raising costs for some bulky, lightweight packages. Then on Oct. 18, 7,625 ZIP codes that previously received standard pricing moved into a new rate group for discounted Ground Advantage labels sold through eBay, according to Value Added Resource .
Other changes in the filing
Fees for some special services are changing, including address enhancement and premium forwarding. Competitive PO Box prices won't change in January. USPS is adding an optional Outbound Proof of Delivery service for Priority Mail International and extending Delivered Duty Paid service to International Priority Airmail. Stamp prices aren't changing.
What shippers should do
The PRC still has to review the proposal (Docket No. CP2027-1). In the meantime, shippers can use the proposed January rate tables to see what their most common shipments would cost. Sellers that offer free or flat-rate shipping can use those estimates to see whether their current thresholds still cover postage.
USPS plans to review the surcharge in July based on fuel prices in the first half of 2027, which means shipping costs could shift midyear again.
